# Shreyash Tripathi

## Summary

Shreyash Tripathi is a Computer Science Engineering student (B.Tech, JECRC University) and full-stack developer. He builds typed, production-grade web apps with React, Next.js, Node.js and Express, designs REST APIs and real-time features, and applies machine learning to make web products smarter. He is currently an AI Trainee at Garage Productions Pvt. Ltd.
